hits.tldr: Theme variables in the breakpoint namespace define responsive variants for conditional styling at specific viewport widths.
Define custom breakpoints using `--breakpoint-*` theme variables in Tailwind CSS.
Remove default Tailwind breakpoints by resetting to `initial` and define custom ones.
Override default theme variables by redefining them in @theme or reset entire namespaces with asterisk syntax.
Use min and max variants with arbitrary values for one-off custom breakpoints.

hits.tldr: Migrate from theme() function to CSS variables; use CSS variable names in theme() where needed.
New max-* and min-* variants enable max-width media queries and arbitrary breakpoint ranges in Tailwind CSS.
Use @variant directive to apply Tailwind variants in custom CSS, stacking or comma-separating multiple variants.
Stack responsive and max-* variants to apply styles only within a specific breakpoint range.
The @supports variant applies styles conditionally based on CSS feature support in the user's browser.
